description: Build (or return the cached, under 24 h) record for one organization id from search_organizations, e.g. sx:sec:0000320193 or sx:irs:530196605. Every fact carries as_of and the source_url of the filing it came from; failed or empty sources are listed in gaps. Free: 50 records a day per caller; a Seraphix API key (Authorization: Bearer) raises the limit. Organizations only.
name: get_organization_record
title: Get an organization record built from public filings
